verdicts.summary: A steer into an already-running untracked run attaches delegatedTaskId to that run, but the run's terminal write drops the link, so the follow-up task never finalizes and the parent is never woken.
evidence: apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/Orchestrator.ts:6878-6883 recordSubagentFollowup emits run.updated {...run, delegatedTaskId: taskId} on the existing running run
apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/RunExecutionService.ts:642-650 terminal finalizedRun is built from input.run (start snapshot) and strips only delegatedCompletion
apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/ProviderTurnStartService.ts:1225-1236 startRootRun receives runningRun as the start snapshot
apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/ProjectionStore.ts:634-649 preserveRunRecordedFields keeps delegatedCompletion and restartCancelledBackgroundWork but not delegatedTaskId
apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/ProjectionStore.ts:1886-1890 SQL run upsert writes the terminal payload without preservation
verdicts.consequence: The follow-up subagent task stays pending or running forever. The parent is not woken with the completion. Restart recovery keys off task status, so it does not repair this.
verdicts.scenario: Monitor-notification wake run R starts. A follow-up steer is then delivered into R, so R gets delegatedTaskId=T. R completes; the terminal run.updated is built from the start snapshot without T, and projection apply does not preserve T. T is never matched by delegatedTaskRun at finalization.
verdicts.missing: Terminal run writes should preserve delegatedTaskId from the stored run, or the start snapshot should be refreshed before the terminal write.

verdicts.summary: Lock acquisition order is consistent. Parent then child for message.dispatch, sequential (never nested) for terminal handling, and parent-only for recovery. No path reaches the locking dispatch while a thread lock is held, so the non-reentrant lock cannot self-deadlock.
evidence: apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/Orchestrator.ts:10850-10870 dispatchWithReceipt takes P then C
apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/Orchestrator.ts:10872-10916 handleTerminalRun takes child and parent locks sequentially
apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/Orchestrator.ts:10956 and 11063 recovery takes only the parent lock
apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/EffectWorker.ts:188-254 dispatch calls hold no lock
apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/RestartContinuation.ts:156-169 dispatch is reached from EffectWorker.ts:113 with no lock held

verdicts.summary: The SQL and in-memory recovery predicates for subagent-results match, so restart recovery sees the same set of threads in both stores.
evidence: apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/ProjectionStore.ts:537-583 in-memory needsRecovery
apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/ProjectionStore.ts:3576-3616 SQL getRecoveryThreadIds clause for subagent-results
apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/ProjectionStore.ts:6139-6150 memory recovery call site

verdicts.summary: The thread_send taskId is read from the projection after the dispatch commits, so the response carries the committed delegatedTaskId rather than a pre-commit guess.
evidence: apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/ThreadManagementService.ts:636-644 re-reads the run after orchestrator.dispatch
apps/server/src/mcp/OrchestratorMcpService.ts:2470-2479 taskId taken from result.run.delegatedTaskId
apps/server/src/mcp/OrchestratorMcpService.ts:351-365 delegatedTaskRun prefers delegatedTaskId match

verdicts.summary: The web and client-runtime edge status derivation looks consistent, but the restart-hold case is unresolved. There, the child's latest run is cancelled, so whether activityRunStatus is null depends on isActivityRunForShell, which I did not read.
evidence: packages/client-runtime/src/state/threadRelationships.ts:92-94 thread edge status = activityRunStatus ?? status
packages/client-runtime/src/state/threadRelationships.ts:97-110 subagent edge status = child?.activityRunStatus ?? (latestRunId != null ? child.status : subagent.status)
packages/client-runtime/src/state/subagentRuntime.ts:133 projectedSubagentsToRuntime status passthrough
apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/ProjectionStore.ts:1409-1412 activityRun filters with isActivityRunForShell (definition not read)
verdicts.missing: Definition of isActivityRunForShell and the restart-hold shell state, to confirm the edge status shown for a held child.

verdicts.summary: My earlier review only recorded this note as looking safe. I did not re-verify its specific claim against the code in this pass, so this verdict is low confidence.
verdicts.missing: Re-check note 5's text against the cited code before relying on a verdict.

verdicts.summary: Extra hazard: a queued follow-up's subagent task and turn item stay pending until the run is terminal, because nothing syncs task status when the run starts. This is a cosmetic UI issue, not a correctness break.
evidence: apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/Orchestrator.ts:6828 status is pending while queued
apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/Orchestrator.ts:6987 and 10207 are the only subagent.updated writers for delivery and terminal state
apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/Orchestrator.ts:1290-1330 startNextQueuedRun does not sync task status
verdicts.consequence: The subagent card shows pending while the child is actually running, until the run ends.
verdicts.scenario: A queued follow-up starts running. Its task and turn item remain pending until terminal.
